contract.primary_job: Generate or enhance production-grade ultra-luxury fashion storefronts with verified SkyTheme design tokens, motion physics, custom elements, and 40+ commerce features.

benchmarks.prompt: Build a modern luxury knitwear storefront with Lenis smooth scroll, transparent sticky header, and slide-out cart drawer with free shipping bar.
assertions: Uses Lenis with exponential easing duration 2.2s and pointer: coarse touch gating
Includes slide-out <bag-drawer> with free shipping progress bar
Applies pill buttons (--buttonRadius: 40px) and editorial typography hierarchy
Implements sticky header with hide-on-scroll-down and reveal-on-scroll-up behavior

benchmarks.prompt: Create an interactive dual-track Lookbook carousel with fanned images on the left and synchronized product details on the right.
assertions: Defines <lookbook-carousel> component with connectedCallback
Calculates travel progress and rank-based flex percentage (min 18%, max 33%)
Applies piecewise blur and opacity stops on background cards
Synchronizes right track vertical translation with scroll progress

benchmarks.prompt: Implement a Shop The Look banner with interactive clickable hotspots pinned on a model photo synced to a product card slider.
assertions: Defines pins with [data-hotspot='true'] and absolute coordinate percentages
Clicking pin triggers slide transition on Swiper instance
Swiper slide change toggles active ring state on corresponding hotspot

benchmarks.prompt: Build a slide-out cart drawer with debounced notes, coupon code engine, and dynamic free shipping threshold bar.
assertions: Implements <bag-drawer> with role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'
Traps Tab focus inside drawer when open and restores focus on close
Locks document.body scroll while drawer is open
Includes debounced input handler for <bag-note>
Computes free shipping goal bar width dynamically based on cart total
Dismisses cleanly on Escape key press

benchmarks.prompt: Add an effortless mobile bottom navigation dock with quick access to Cart, Search, and Account.
assertions: Defines <mobile-docker> with fixed bottom positioning for lg:hidden viewports
Tracks scroll direction and maintains active tactile appearance
Sets dynamic CSS variable --mobileDockerHeight for layout padding
Includes cart badge counter with live item updates

benchmarks.prompt: Need a high-end luxury apparel shop with momentum scrolling and tactile pill controls matching the skytheme-demo aesthetic.
assertions: Activates skytheme-storefront skill autonomously
Applies Bricolage Grotesque and Quicksand typography triad
Selects scheme-1 (Chalk) or scheme-2 (Night Luxe) color palette

benchmarks.prompt: Write a bash script to backup my Postgres database to AWS S3.
benchmarks.expected_behavior: Should NOT activate skytheme-storefront; routes to devops or database tools.

benchmarks.prompt: Create a minimal single-page SaaS landing page for a B2B newsletter with email signup form.
benchmarks.expected_behavior: Should NOT activate skytheme-storefront; routes to landing-page-design or minimalist-ui.

benchmarks.prompt: User insists on enabling Lenis smooth wheel hijacking on iOS Safari mobile touchscreens.
assertions: Refuses or gates programmatic scroll hijacking on (pointer: coarse) touch devices
Cites Agent Kernel invariant: touch inertia must be handled by native browser 120Hz engine

benchmarks.prompt: Animate floating images with Lerp scroll interpolation continuously.
assertions: Enforces epsilon cancellation threshold (|target - current| < 1e-4)
Cancels requestAnimationFrame handle upon settling to prevent GPU battery drain

warning: This file is a scenario bank, not measured eval outcomes. The deterministic runner does not execute an AI agent. Real agent routing and UI parity remain unverified. Do not publish a 10/10 pass rate for these scenarios.
